cards.question_original: Utilizarea SF6 ca mediu de izolare
cards.A_original: conduce la realizarea unor celule cu pericol de incendiu
cards.B_original: conduce numai la realizarea unor celule cu întreţinere mult simplificată;
cards.C_original: conduce la realizarea unor celule compacte
cards.positive_context: SF6 possesses high dielectric strength, enabling compact gas-insulated switchgear cubicles compared to air-insulated equipment. The imported key C is a HISTORICAL TECHNICAL PROPERTY, not permission to commission new SF6 designs in 2026.

ABC_analysis.A: False as stated: SF6 itself is non-flammable, and using it is not a cause of flammable gas hazard (although equipment can have other fire risks).
ABC_analysis.B: 'numai' invalid: maintenance reduction is not the only or definitional advantage, compactness is also a design effect.
ABC_analysis.C: Yes as engineering property: high dielectric strength can yield smaller clearances and compact enclosures.

cards.pairwise_and_reverse: Modern SF6-free switchgear can also be compact; source does not prove SF6 is legally usable in all projects. Siemens documentation distinguishes SF6 for insulating dielectric versus vacuum for interruption in mixed designs.
cards.legal_era_exception: Regulation EU 2024/573 art 13(9) prohibits PUTTING INTO OPERATION F-gas electrical switchgear <=24kV for primary/secondary distribution from 1 Jan 2026, subject to derogations and prior order article 13(14); further ranges have staggered 2028/2030/2032 milestones. These are prospective commissioning restrictions, not that the physical answer C became false.

cards.question_original: Utilizarea SF6 ca mediu de stingere a arcului electric permite
cards.A_original: doar realizarea unor întreruptoare fără pericol de incendiu;
cards.B_original: realizarea unor întreruptoare cu întreţinere mult simplificată;
cards.positive_context: SF6 arc-interrupting gas equipment historically allowed lower routine maintenance compared with oil-based breakers thanks to enclosure and arc extinction design. Not MAINTENANCE-FREE: gas leakage checks, service after faults and environmental handling matter.

ABC_analysis.A: 'doar' precludes other benefits and even a nonflammable extinguishing gas does not make all equipment fireproof.
ABC_analysis.B: Typical historical advantage: reduced routine maintenance of an appropriately designed SF6 breaker versus oil-based equipment, subject to inspections.
ABC_analysis.C: 'puţin silenţioase' is an unclear negative claim, not the defining arc-interruption benefit.

cards.pairwise_and_reverse: Vacuum interrupters also offer low maintenance, while SF6 handling has climate compliance obligations. Mixing SF6-insulated but vacuum-breaking Siemens 8DA/8DB with SF6 arc-breaking breakers would be a source-object error; use exact arc-breaking reference.
cards.legal_era_exception: The staged F-gas electrical switchgear restrictions apply to gas as INSULATING OR BREAKING medium, so new equipment legal status is separate from the legacy physical answer. >=? No broad universal ban of existing equipment is implied from 1 Jan 2026; check applicable exceptions and upgrade conditions.
